name: Revdoku
description: Email mailboxes with shared file storage for people and AI agents. Receive and read messages and attachments, and share files through authorized mailbox access.

authentication.signup: Public MCP signup tools require email, accept_terms_and_policy=true and private email verification; see https://revdoku.com/mcp.md#direct-mcp-signup

skills.name: Email mailboxes for people and AI agents
skills.description: Create an mailbox with mailbox_create and check email.receiving_enabled. Use mailbox_email_list with a saved cursor, mailbox_email_get for decoded messages, and mailbox_email_download for originals and attachments.

skills.name: Private cloud storage for AI
skills.description: Store, read, write, append, and restore files through authorized account connections. Humans and authorized AI apps collaborate on the same files and folders.
